---
title: "Popularity of Isabella, Sophia, and Savannah Over Time"
format:
  html:
    fig-format: svg
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the SSA baby names dataset
baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

# Filter for Isabella, Sophia, and Savannah
selected_names <- baby_names |>
  filter(name %in% c("Isabella", "Sophia", "Savannah"), sex == "F")

# Pick points every 10 years and at each name's peak for the baby icons
baby_points <- selected_names |>
  group_by(name) |>
  filter(year %% 15 == 0 | count == max(count)) |>
  ungroup()
```

The chart below shows the number of female babies named **Isabella**, **Sophia**, and **Savannah** in the United States each year from 1880 to 2025, using data from the Social Security Administration.

```{r}
#| dev: svglite
ggplot(selected_names, aes(x = year, y = count, color = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = baby_points, label = "👶", size = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Isabella, Sophia, and Savannah in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Name",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
